disclaimer: Synthetic attention proxy ONLY; no LM quality or latency claim.

definitions.normalized_output_mse: Mean across post-warmup steps of ||sparse-dense||^2/(||dense||^2+1e-12); lower is better.
definitions.target_recall: Fraction of post-warmup steps retaining synthetic query target; higher is better.
definitions.counterfactual_coverage: Fraction of full-history, one-token deletion effects attributable to retained positions; offline diagnostic, higher is better.
definitions.attention_pair_ratio: Number of sparse dot products / full-history dot products for post-warmup steps; not runtime.
